notes.title: Pro Cup Invitational 2
notes.content: Introducing the Pro Cup Invitational 2 - an invite-only tournament featuring eight of the highest-ranked players in Hot Lap League PLUS 8 of the top qualifiers in our qualifying round. More info can be found on our Discord - https://discord.gg/N6gAYTf7E8

notes.title: Nominate Us!
notes.content: Nominate Hot Lap League for The Steam Awards and help bring more players to this league!

notes.title: Pro Cup Invitational
notes.content: Get ready for the Pro Cup Invitational - an invite-only tournament featuring eight of the highest-ranked players in Hot Lap League. The best of the best are going head to head - make sure you catch it all live on our Discord - https://discord.gg/N6gAYTf7E8

notes.title: Discord Competition
notes.content: In celebration of surprise World Records, we're issuing a challenge for our Discord members. Head over now to join in - https://discord.gg/N6gAYTf7E8

notes.title: Hot Lap League: Deluxe Edition Steam Launch Date
notes.content: The wait is almost over! Hot Lap League will officially be released on Steam at 7 pm (UTC) August 23, 2022. PLUS, to celebrate its launch, we are having a sale! Don't miss out! How will you stack up on PC?

notes.title: Gamescom 2022
notes.content: Ultimate Studio is going to Gamescom 2022 with the Australian Trade and Investment Commission (Austrade) and Interactive Games & Entertainment Association (IGEA). You can find us at the Australian Partner Country Pavilion and Unity's booth! Come play Hot Lap League and say Hello for a sneak peek at some other projects 🤫
